notes: Calendar-year season: the 2026 tournament is the one that overlaps the 2026-27 career year, so '2026' is the real label. 2026 is a single double round-robin of 30 matchdays, confirmed on 23 March 2026; the former Apertura/Clausura structure is not used. Relegation uses promedio (average points over the last two seasons): the bottom club goes down and the second-from-bottom plays a promotion/relegation play-off against the Copa Simón Bolívar runner-up, while the Copa Simón Bolívar champion is promoted directly. That second level is a cup feeding from regional leagues, not a league in our rows, so the league is closed downwards in our data. Play-off leg count not documented. No cups or continental places included.
